Forte University Online Learning

Within our Forte University Learning Hub, you’ll discover financial courses, instructional tutorials and how-tos, games, articles, calculators, and progress tracking to help you achieve your goals.

Create your profile

Sign up for this complimentary service and complete your personalized profile to begin your customized learning experience based on your goals.

Get Started

Know your money personality

Are you a spender? A saver? Short-term or long-term planner? Take the money personality quiz for insight into your relationship with money and tips to help overcome some harmful habits.

Take the quiz

Financial checkup

Complete your financial wellness checkup to measure progress you’ve made toward your financial goals and to unlock custom content.

Get checked up

Life stage learning

We’ve selected these articles and classes based on your life stage. 

Teens

You’re balancing a lot — school work, a job, time with family and friends, and figuring out what to do in your future. We hope these resources help you get a handle on budgeting, using credit cards, and preparing for school-related finances.

  • Budgeting
  • Student Life
  • Applying for the FAFSA
  • Preparing for College
  • Understanding Paychecks
  • Interviews

Individuals and Families

You have commitments to work, family, friends, and are still trying to have time (and money) for yourself and your goals for the future. We’re thrilled to share these resources with you, and hope they assist as you navigate life.

  • Financial Stress
  • Budgeting
  • Credit
  • Family Matters
  • For Parents

Business Owners

Business owners are always seeking more time. That’s why we’re happy to offer you the below resources to help you effectively start and manage your business, which you can review at a time and place most convenient for you.

  • Entrepreneurship
  • Office Culture
  • Taxes
  • Identity Theft
  • Tech

Join Our Monthly Challenge!

Improve your money skills and enter to be eligible to win every month! Click the “start the challenge” button below, sign up or log in, learn about the monthly topic, then answer a few quick questions. For each month you participate, you’ll be eligible to win $1,000 from Enrich.

START THE CHALLENGE

Additional Resources

Whether buying a home, starting or growing a business, planning how to pay rising tuition costs or preparing for retirement, we hope the following resources and regular meetings with our well-trained team will guide you to make the best decisions for you, your family or your business.

For Individuals and Families:

  • FDIC Consumer News for content on home ownership, budgeting, planning for the future and more
  • Federal Trade Commission Consumer Information for content on credit, homebuying, privacy, online security, scams and more
  • Understanding Escrow
  • Tips for Consumers: What to do Post-Equifax Breach
  • Stop.Think.Connect. for online security information from the Department of Homeland Security
  • First Aid and Disaster Preparedness
  • Emergency Preparedness Checklist
  • Federal Student Aid — FAFSA
  • Tuition Break for New England Residents

For Businesses:

  • Small Business Administration Resources
  • U.S. Department of Labor
  • Federal Trade Commission Business Center for content on marketing, credit, privacy, security and more

Disclaimer: Links to third party websites are provided for your convenience only. Nebula Trust Bank does not provide, offer, sponsor, endorse nor guarantee any offerings, products, or information of the third party providers, Nebula Trust Bank is not liable for any failure of any products and services promoted by any third party provider. Our privacy and security policies do not apply to the linked third party websites. You should read the privacy and security policies of any third party sites as they may be different from those of Nebula Trust Bank.
